'''Legal Arms Ltd.''' was a company that sold arms legally during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==History==
The [[Human/Legends|Humans]] [[Jarl Narvis]] and [[Gille Narvis]], a [[Marriage/Legends|married]] couple, jointly owned the company. Jarl was [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] of the company's [[Barloz-class medium freighter|''Barloz''-class freighter]] ''[[Aggressive Negotiation]]'', while Gille was its accountant. The [[Cularin Militia]] paid the company for some weapons during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and Jarl flew the ''Aggressive Negotiation'' to the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]] with them aboard it. However, before he could deliver the cargo, the ship encountered a [[Thaereian military]] patrol and was boarded. The Thaereians killed Jarl and all of the crew except Gille and her and Jarl's daughter, [[Kalee Narvis]]. The ship was left dead in space and the [[Heroes of Cularin]] arrived to rescue Gille and Kalee. Gille continued to run the company as the sole owner of it.
